evidence.quote: Hunt players are invited to follow the thread and take part in an epic three-stage Community Event titled Make Them Bleed, earning points by killing monsters, hunting down Targets, and interacting with Blood Wells.
Each Blood Well grants a new Burn Trait—Siphon, which lets players loot a Scarce Trait from a fallen enemy Hunter, leaving the “Siphon” Trait in exchange.
Stage 2 brings a new Burn Trait, Chupacabra, that allows Hunters to restore one Health Chunk through interaction with animals.
Blood Testament also increases the vast Hunt arsenal by bringing the Burgess foldable slide-action shotgun.
The first stage of Make Them Bleed unlocks a new dynamic night cycle transforming the game: Blood Moon.
When Warren Russett lost everything, Lynch offered him a blood serum that awoke an insatiable thirst for blood.
